name: Autophobia VR
summary:
Step into the surreal and unsettling world of Autophobia, a liminal space exploration game that combines the eerie beauty of forgotten places with the dynamic movement of your own hands. Navigate endless corridors, abandoned malls, surreal bathrooms, and otherworldly environments that blur the line between dreams and reality.

Leap, climb, and swing through hauntingly atmospheric spaces with intuitive, physics-based locomotion. Uncover cryptic clues, solve puzzles, and unravel the mystery of how you got her
